Problem Statement:
Insertion sort is the sorting mechanism where the sorted array is built having one item at a time. The array elements are compared with each other sequentially and then arranged simultaneously in some particular order.You have to sort the given array of integer values in insertion sort manner. 
Input Description:
Given an integer 'n' which indicates the length of array and next line followed by space separated ‘n’ integer values.Where 1 
Output Description:
Print step by step process of applying insertion sort(print all the iteration of insertion sorting process).where -10000

From the given input values 3 8 5 4 1 9 -2 Take 3 fix it
3 8 5 4 1 9 -2 Take 8 fix to sort 3 8
